dialog.title: Change saved recording
dialog.description: Review the change, prepare its table, then confirm when new recording begins.
dialog.recovery_available: A saved recording change still needs your attention.
dialog.unknown_no_replacement: The outcome is not confirmed. Keep this operation; do not create a replacement or prepare another table.
dialog.saved_basis: This starts from the server’s saved recording rules, not unsaved edits. Sources and recording meaning stay unchanged.
dialog.name: Recording name
dialog.compatibility_checked: The server verifies the complete same-engine layout and destination rules before anything is reserved.
dialog.basic_same_shape: Basic recording is recreated with the original layout, destination and complete source set.
dialog.history_kept: Existing tables, history and receipts are kept. Already accepted data continues to its original destination.
dialog.blocked: This change cannot proceed with the current evidence.
dialog.repair_source: Refresh the saved recording and resolve its blocking reason before reviewing again.
dialog.required_checks: The destination still needs a capability check. It is checked only after you confirm reservation.
dialog.reserved: Settings reserved — new recording has not started.
dialog.schema_confirmation_required: Review this plan. Table preparation runs only when you explicitly confirm it.
dialog.schema_confirmed: Table preparation confirmed — new recording has not started.
dialog.scheduled: The start or switch has been recorded for the confirmed time.
dialog.observed_boundary: Ownership follows the source observation time: before this boundary stays with the old generation; at or after it uses the new generation.
dialog.not_delivery_evidence: This is configuration evidence, not proof that a device is running or SQL rows have been committed.
dialog.first_start_explanation: This is the first activation. No historical active generation is ended.
dialog.cutover_explanation: The reviewed switch keeps old history and redirects only eligible new observations.

errors.unavailable: This action is currently blocked. Refresh saved recording details and check its available actions.
errors.stale: The saved revisions have changed. Do not confirm an outdated review; check the original operation or refresh the saved recording.
errors.failed: The review could not be completed. Refresh the saved recording and try the review again.
errors.unknown: The response was not confirmed. Check the exact original operation before any retry.
errors.status_failed: The original operation could not be read. Its previous result is retained; try checking again.
errors.boundary: Choose a future time and review it again before confirming.
errors.storage: The browser could not retain recovery details. No new request was sent; allow session storage and check the saved operation.
errors.unreadable: This browser recovery record is unreadable. Only the original operation status may be checked; no replacement is allowed.

dialog.preview_not_submitted: The original operation confirms no table preparation was submitted. You may explicitly request another preview for the same reserved settings.
dialog.readback_received: The original operation status was read. The unreadable local request remains locked; no new action was sent.
